entry.name: peak
entry.description: Compares a number to a previous peak-value and, if larger, it is sent out the output while the new peak-value is set to that number.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: The initial value stored inis. Providing a float argument will cause peak to operate with floating point numbers instead of integers.

messages.name: bang
messages.description: Sends the currently stored peak value out the left outlet.

messages.name: float
messages.description: In left inlet: If the input is greater than the value currently stored in, it is stored as the new peak value and is sent out.

messages.name: ft1
messages.description: In right inlet: The number is stored in peak as the new peak value, and is sent out.

messages.name: in1
messages.description: In right inlet: The number is stored in peak as the new peak value, and is sent out.

messages.name: int
messages.description: In left inlet: If the input is greater than the value currently stored in, it is stored as the new peak value and is sent out.

messages.name: list
messages.description: In left inlet: The second number is stored as the new peak value and is sent out, then the first number is received in the left inlet.

outlets.digest: Goes high for a new peak
